g.text: Unified Session Update - Complete Target Class View
No credentials and no mutable Agent.
Recheck version and state under the row lock.
Any execution field: idle, even for equal values.
One version increment; all fields/events or none.
Green: existing. Amber: extended. Blue: new target-only.
Preparation methods must not independently commit.
All nonempty subsets of the four fields are accepted atomically.
